description: Change fields of a voice agent: prompt, firstMessage, voiceId, llm, language, maxDurationSeconds, outcomeFields, successCriteria, name, or any platform field through raw. Only what is passed changes. Free. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

firstMessage.description: its first line; empty string = it waits for the caller

llm.description: the language model, e.g. gpt-4.1, claude-haiku-5-5, openai/gpt-4.1 (Vapi provider/model)

outcomeFields.description: facts to pull out of every call (e.g. an appointment time as a string), each with a name, a type (string, number, boolean or enum with options) and a description

prompt.description: the instructions the agent follows on every call

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected

raw.description: any field of the platform's own agent body, merged over Hermoso's (Retell: raw.llm for the Retell LLM)

successCriteria.description: what a successful call is; the platform grades each call against it

summary.description: write a summary after each call

voiceModel.description: the TTS model, e.g. eleven_flash_v2_5 (Retell, ElevenLabs)

voiceProvider.description: Vapi: the voice's provider, e.g. vapi, 11labs, cartesia, openai

voicemailMessage.description: what it says on reaching voicemail

name: update_voice_agent
title: Update a voice agent
